item.title: Ask HN: What is a good format for a tool to report data to a LLM?
item.summary: For CLI tools, humans like visually organized text possibly with colors or TUIs. Machines likes tabs-separated tabular data, or json and similar. What's the equivalent for LLMs for tabular or structured data? What makes them grasp the data easily and efficiently?
